image_description: A red lionfish (Pterois volitans) resting on a sandy substrate in an aquarium environment. The fish displays characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins, and elongated dorsal spines. Background includes green aquatic plants and dark water, with significant glare/reflection on the glass surface.
